Commentary.Commentary: The pitch is a good one for batting but there is some assistance for the bowlers, especially for the spinners. The African minnows will have to bat sensibly and plan their innings accordingly. The pair of Rangana Herath and Dilruwan Perera can prove to be a real threat. Stay tuned for Zimbabwe's reply after the tea break...

Zimbabwe weren't consistent enough in their bowling. They produced some great balls here and there but altogether their bowling department lacked intent and to add to their misery, plenty of chances went down as well. Graeme Cremer and Donald Tiripano were the standout bowlers, bagging 6 wickets together. Hamilton Masakadza also chipped in with a couple of wickets early on to give jitters to Sri Lanka.

Right then, a spirited batting performance by the Sri Lankan lower half has powered them to a big first innings total. Yesterday, the pair of Dhananjaya de Silva and Upul Tharanga bailed them out from a precarious situation and today Asela Gunaratne did the bulk of scoring. He notched up his maiden Test ton and added vital runs with the tail.

OUT! STUMPED! Zimbabwe manage to bowl out Sri Lanka. Tossed up outside off, Gunaratne comes down the track and swings hard but is not to the pitch of the ball. Peter Moor whips off the bails easily. Gunaratne does not even bother to go back. SRI LANKA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 504 AT TEA ON DAY 2!

EDGED, SAFE! Full and wide outside off, Kumara comes down the track and swings wildly. Gets a thick outside edge which flies over slip to third man. A fielder comes before slip gets to the ball and prevents the boundary. Three runs taken.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman tries to sweep but fails to make contact.
A short ball wide outside off, Asela slashes hard but misses.
FOUR! Ferocious! 500 UP FOR SRI LANKA! Short and wide outside off, Gunaratne backs away and slaps it over point for a boundary! The stand moves to 30.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Very wide outside off, left alone.
Full and wide outside off, pushed wide of point but no run taken.
Comes down the track, yorks himself but works it towards mid-wicket.
CHRIS MPOFU has been brought back on to try and finish this off.
The googly outside off, Lahiru plays inside the line and gets beaten.
FOUR! Creamed! Full and outside off, Kumara gets down and clobbers it over mid on for a boundary to get off the mark in style!
Dropped short around middle, tucked through square leg for a single.
Mid-wicket moves to square leg now.
FOUR! Very nicely played. Full and around middle and leg, Gunaratne gets down and gently paddles it fine for a boundary. Moves to 111 and the stand is worth 21.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket. Again, no run taken.
Tossed up outside off, Gunaratne comes down the track and lofts it towards sweeper cover. It does not carry. They do not take the single either.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover again.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover.
On a good length outside off, LK keeps his bat inside the line.
Full and wide outside off, Lahiru pushes at it and gets a thick outside edge which does not carry to the keeper.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
NO BALL. Tiripano hits the stumps at the bowler's end while bowling and umpire Gould spots it and signals a no ball. It was a bouncer outside off, swayed away from.
DROPPED! Easy chance. Full and wide outside off, Kumara backs away and steers it straight to Sean Williams at gully who fluffs it.
SIX! What a hit! Floated on middle and off, Gunaratne comes down the track again and lofts it over long on for a biggie!
Maiden Test ton for Gunaratne!

MISCUE, BUT SAFE! Gunaratne gets it. Nerves almost got the better of him. Full and outside off, Gunaratne dances down the track and looks to go down the ground but gets a top edge. Luckily for him, the ball clears mid off running back and lands just out of his reach. Two runs taken and that will do for Gunaratne who takes off his helmet and smiles. It is more of a relief. He was not far from being dismissed on 99.
Stays back in his crease and defends.
On middle and off, watchfully pushed back.
Full again, defended towards short mid-wicket.
Full on middle and off, pushed past short mid-wicket towards mid on.
A play and a miss! On a good length outside off, Kumara plays inside the line and is just about beaten! That was so close to the outside edge!
Length ball wide outside off, punched through the covers for a single to move to 99.
One more in that channel, left alone again.
Three in a row, full and wide outside off, not played at.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Full and wide outside off, allowed to go through.
Full and outside off, easily pushed down to long off for a single to move to 98. Poor captaincy from Cremer on keeping mid off back.
Full on middle and off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, defended down the pitch.
Thrown up outside off, spinning away, shouldered arms to.

Shorter around off, stays low, worked towards deep mid-wicket. Hamilton Masakadza does not move an inch, challenging the batsmen to try and see whether they can get a couple but Asela is not even interested in the single.
Full and outside off, slowly looped up, Gunaratne blocks it down.
DRINKS BREAK.
Good leave. Full and outside off, straightening a touch, Lahiru covers the line and shoulders arms. Safely negotiated.
Puts it on a fuller length around off, Lahiru defends it to the off side.
Wicket to wicket line, on a fuller length, it's defended with a straight bat by Lahiru.
Tiripano comes from around the wicket and angles in a full ball on off, Kumara defends it to the off side.

A touch short and outside off, Asela runs it down to third man and runs the first run hard. But the fielder in the deep shows great awareness, quickly gets to the ball and sends in the throw. Only one run possible. Sean Williams was the fielder! Now, Kumara has 4 balls to survive.
Full and angling into the batsman, Asela defends it by getting forward.
The field gets spread out for Asela Gunaratne.
Tossed up ball on off, Kumara gets forward in defense but edges it wide of first slip. It races through, there is a chance for a couple but they decide not to take it. Hmmm...
Leg slip comes into place.
Loopy full ball on off, Lahiru lunges and defends it back.
Flatter and fuller on middle, knocked down through mid on for a single. Can Kumara survive two balls?
Tossed up ball on off, spinning away, Asela plays inside the line and misses.
FOUR! Just over backward point. Flighted leg spinner on middle, Asela goes down and plays a reverse slog over the jumping fielder for a boundary.
Flatter leg spinner on off, defended off the back foot.
LAHIRU KUMARA is the last man in. Can he hang in long enough for Gunaratne to reach his ton?

OUT! Off stump goes for a walk! Tiripano runs in from over the wicket and angles in a full ball on off, Lakmal tries to defend it from the crease but it stays low and sneaks through to uproot the off stump. Oh dear, Asela Gunaratne is at the other end on 91 with only one wicket remaining. Good thing is that he now will have the strike and would look to farm it. Can he score a century and also take Sri Lanka past 500?
Back of a length ball on off, punched off the back foot to covers.
SURANGA LAKMAL walks in at number 10, replacing Herath.

OUT! Here is the wicket Zimbabwe dearly wanted! Tiripano hurls across another short delivery outside off, Herath tries to emulate the last shot (square cut) but this time fails to middle it as it's too close to his body. A faint edge goes behind to the keeper who for a change doesn't drop. End of a 75-run stand!
FOUR! Good shot! Short and wide outside off, sitting up nicely for the batsman, Herath camps back and whacks it through backward point for a boundary.
Length ball angling into the batsman, Rangana gets behind the line and offers a straight blade in defense.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, Herath defends it off his back foot.

Goodness gracious me, how did that miss the off stump? A nicely tossed up ball on off, curving away just a shade, Asela offers no shot only to realize that it goes perilously past the off stump. He failed to cover the line there, one of those things. He is on 91!
Flighted and on the pads, defended to the on side.
Loopy full ball on off, Asela defends it by getting on the front foot.
Tossed up ball on off, it's reverse swept through covers for a single.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Flighted delivery on off, Herath kneels and slogs it with the spin over mid-wicket. One bounce to the fielder in the deep and they take a single.
Shortish and outside off, Gunaratne reaches out for it and mistimes his punch shot to covers. Straight to the fielder.
Slightly short in length around leg, Herath turns it through backward square leg for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Asela goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Fullish and on off, Herath gets forward, opens the face of the bat and pushes it through covers for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Asela slaps it to sweeper cover, straight towards the fielder for a single.
Fuller and straighter, tucked off the pads through square leg for a single.
DONALD TIRIPANO is back for another burst.
Gets forward to defend but it comes off the inside edge and rolls wide of short leg for a run.
Tossed up ball on leg, turned to fne leg for a single.
This one is very full on middle, it squeezed out through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, defended from the back foot.
Full flighted ball on off, defended back to the bowler.
Shortish on off, it's punched off the back foot to covers.
Bowls it full and just around off, angling away, Rangana covers the line, shows great restrain and allows it through to the keeper.
Short and wide outside off, cut behind point for one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

EDGY FOUR! Not a bowler's game! Back of a length ball on off, extra bounce, Asela tries to punch it through the line from the back foot but gets a thick outside edge. It flies right through the gap between first slip and gully for a boundary.
FOUR! Lovely shot, lovely shot indeed! Fullish and angling into the batsman, Gunaratne gets forward and flicks it sweetly past the diving mid on fielder for a boundary.
Full and wide outside off, Herath forces it to mid off and scampers across for a brisk single as the fielder scores a direct hit at his end. He was safely in though.
Turning down the leg side, Herath fails to flick and it goes off his pads through vacant leg slip. A leg bye taken.
50-run stand between Herath and Gunaratne.

Crucial stand this! Flighted and on middle, Asela tries to work it through mid-wicket but it goes off the inside half of the bat and sneaks past the right side of the short leg fielder. A single taken.
Quicker and flatter on middle, defended off the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and flighted outside off, driven off the front foot to mid off.

Nearly a run out! Flighted ball on middle, Herath walks forward with the flick shot an Ervine at backward short leg shows good reflexes to stop it. He has an immediate shy at the striker's end but misses and now the batsmen cross for an overthrow.
Good length ball outside off, Gunaratne stands back and tries to slap it through the line but fails to connect. It goes low to the keeper who does well to collect it.

Four byes! Masakadza loses his radar and slips a full ball down the leg side. Asela fails to flick it and the keeper is blinded for a while. He too fails to stop it and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Brings a full ball back into the batsman with the angle, Gunaratne goes back and offers a straight bat in defense.
Beaten! Lovely delivery, on a fuller length around off, nipping away a shade, Asela plays inside the line from the back foot and gets beaten.
Angles in a gentle full ball on off, Asela gets on the front foo and pushes it to mid off.
Fullish and on off, defended with soft hands to point.
Once again lunges and defends it with his bat and pad together.
Full and floated on off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Herath goes down on one knee and plays the conventional sweep shot through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quicker leg spinner, Herath defends it off the inside half of the bat towards short leg.
Floated one on off, Herath reverse sweeps it but finds backward point.
Shorter one on off, Asela goes on the back foot and strokes it to sweeper cover for one.
Goes around the wicket for the final delivery and serves a length ball outside off, Herath shoulders arms.
Tucks it off his pads to the leg side but finds the fielder.
Nearly drags it on! Length ball angling across the batsman, too close to cut, Herath still goes after it and gets a bottom edge. It's on one bounce to the keeper.
On a length and around middle, Herath goes on the back foot and blocks it to short extra cover.
Short again, cut through point and straight to the fielder this time. A single.

FOUR! Masakadza tempts the batsman with a shortish delivery wide outside off, Gunaratne reaches out for it and steers it through backward point. The ball races through and beats the desperate dive in the deep by Tiripano.
A touch short and on off, Herath gets back and defends it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it down with the spin.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good stop! Flighted and on off, Herath bottom edges his attempted reverse sweep and the first slip fielder does well to stop it on one bounce to his right.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it with an angled bat to the off side.
Loopy leg spinner on off, Herath blocks it to the off side.
Another delivery in the corridor outside off, Gunaratne this time has a watchful leave.
Play and a miss! Hamilton gets some away shape there as he tries to tempt the batsman with a wide delivery outside off. Asela flashes and misses.
Good length ball on off, Gunaratne stays back footed and defends it to the off side.

Slight mix-up but no harm done. Full in length and just outside off, Asela taps it down towards point and looks for a run. His skipper sends him back after taking a start. Herath now walks up to him and has a little chat, maybe asking him to take it easy.
A loose delivery, full and sliding down the leg side, Asela tries to paddle sweep but fails to put bat on ball.
An overpitched ball on off, driven firmly off the front foot but straight to the cover fielder.
A little short and around off, Rangana goes on the back foot and taps it to point.
FOUR! Poor delivery, a full toss on off, Herath leans forward and pushes it with good timing through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Too full in length on middle, Gunaratne gets forward and across, lifts his back leg and whips it wide of mid on for a single.
Flatter through the air, full and on off, it's defended from the crease to the off side.
FOUR! A touch short and on off, spinning away, Gunaratne picks it early, goes deep inside the crease and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Flatter leg spinner on off, Asela stays back footed and defends it to the off side.
Pitches it full and in the line of the stumps, Herath lunges and defends it back with a straight bat.
Targets the leg stump with a length delivery, Herath tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to square leg.
Drops it on a fuller length and outside off, Asela drives it through the gap at covers for a single.
Angles in a length ball on off, Gunaratne gets across the stumps and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Fullish and angling in, once again it's pushed off the front foot to mid off.
A gentle fuller delivery on off, it's pushed off the front foot to mid off.
The man with the golden arm, HAMILTON MASAKADZA comes on to bowl now.
Loopy full ball on middle, it's pushed off the pads to wide mid on for a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Attempts to play the reverse sweep but misses. The keeper fails to collect and it goes off his pads towards square leg. A bye taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Four byes! That beat everything. Flighted, full and wide outside off, Herath tries to dig it out but misses. It spins past him after missing the bat as the keeper also fails to collect. It races behind to the fence.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning in, Herath presses forward to defend and keeps it out off the inside half of the bat towards short leg.

Let's see what's the strategy of Sri Lanka, mainly Asela Gunaratne will be. They surely will be eyeing quick runs. Gunaratne holds the key as far as batting with the tail is concerned. Graeme Cremer to bowl...
Welcome back for the afternoon session. The players are back on the field. Zimbabwe get in a huddle as has been the tradition now-a-days. Now, they disperse to take their fielding position.
... DAY 2, SESSION 2 ...

Zimbabwe's bowling was decent but once again they were loose in the field. Graeme Cremer was the standout bowler and got good assistance from the pitch. The hosts would like to restrict the opposition under 450 or less if possible. Do join us in a short while for the post-lunch session.

From here on it's all about how many Sri Lanka will add to their first innings total. Asela Gunaratne has looked excellent in his knock so far and he will hope to receive some support from the tail so that he gets to his maiden Test century.

Good session for Sri Lanka as they have further strengthened their position in this Test match. 124 runs came in the session for the loss of two wickets. Dhananjaya de Silva didn't add much to his overnight score and was the first wicket to fall while after playing a quickfire knock Dilruwan Perera also departed. Both the batsmen were dismissed by skipper Graeme Cremer.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover. LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Full and just outside off, not played at again.
Outside off, allowed to go through.

Full and straight, Herath would have been a goner had he missed his flick. The ball went off the inside edge through square leg and the batsmen took a single. In fact, a leg bye has been signalled! Wonder what Hawk Eye would have shown. There was hardly any appeal made, perhaps even Zimbabwe thought there was an inside edge.
On middle and leg, flicked towards fine leg for a couple.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, Asela lunges to defend but misses and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Short and outside off, punched behind point for a single.
Full on middle, defended towards square leg.
MIX-UP, BUT SAFE! Full on middle, Herath pushes it towards covers and sets off for a single. There was never one available and Gunaratne immediately sent his skipper back who dived into his crease.
Play and a miss. On a good length outside off, Gunaratne feels for it but misses.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Eases this through the covers for a run.
Short and outside off, punched through point for a single.
Outside off, left alone.

FOUR! That is a fantastic shot. A short ball outside off, pulled through mid-wicket via a short-arm jab to the fence! The stand moves to 12 from 15 balls. Gunaratne moves to 61. Can the lower order hang around till his century?
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Reverse! Herath has come out with the idea to entertain. Full and around middle and off, Herath gets down and reverse sweeps it past short third man for a boundary!
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for one. 400 UP FOR SRI LANKA.
Full on middle this time, Rangana gets down and sweeps it powerfully through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, Herath comes forward and defends.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Down the leg side, left alone.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Landed outside off, let through to the keeper.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Short and wide outside off, Gunaratne slashes hard but misses.
A short delivery outside off, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
RANGANA HERATH walks in next, replacing Perera.

OUT! LBW! That was dead plumb. Tossed up around middle, Dilruwan stays back to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Cremer appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Dilruwan asks his partner whether he should review but Gunaratne sends him on his way. Hawk Eye shows that the ball was hitting the off stump.
Pushes this to point for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Dilruwan pushes but misses.
Outside off, left alone.

On middle and leg, gently nudged through mid-wicket. Mid on looks at short leg hoping that he would go and retrieve but short leg is also doing the same, looking at him in the hope that he would retrieve the ball. Eventually, both amble after the ball, giving each other enough opportunity to overtake and finally, mid on gets to the ball. Three runs taken.
Short and outside off, cut towards sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

2nd Test fifty for Asela Gunaratne! Continues with his good run of form. Scored a half ton in the previous Test as well and is making most of the opportunities he has got in the absence of regular players.
There is his half century! What a composed knock. Full and down the leg side, flicked towards deep backward square leg for a single. Raises his bat to the crowd. A good knock.
CARL MUMBA is back for another spell before lunch.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Comes down the track and looks to flick but the ball goes off his pads to short leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.

That has turned a mile! Must have hit a crack. Short and around off, Gunaratne shapes to pull but the ball spins away and shoots low as well. Moor does extremely well to stop it, that too with a glove.
Full and outside off, driven straight to the bowler.
SIX! Crash! A short ball on off, Dilruwan goes back and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie!
Full on middle, gently swept through square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Up and over! Flighted on middle, Perera comes down the track and lofts it over mid on for a boundary!
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.

MISFIELD. That is a bit sloppy. Dilruwan comes down the track and hits this down towards mid on. The fielder gets across and should have stopped it but the ball goes between his legs towards the boundary. He then goes back and slides to prevent the same. Two runs taken.
Short on middle, Gunaratne goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Williams comes on to bowl but Gunaratne backs away. He was not ready as someone moved in front of the sight screen at the last moment.
Goes back and works it towards short leg.
Full and outside off, well kept out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes down the track and defends.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A short ball around off, Dilruwan goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Comes down the track and drives it to long on for a single.
Fuller on middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! That surprised everyone. Landed outside off, Dilruwan lunges to defend but the ball spins in, bounces and goes over the stumps, past the keeper to the fine leg fence. Looked as byes but the umpire signals runs. Replays do not detect any wood.
Full and outside off again, spinning away, DP lets it go.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point.
The googly on middle, Dilruwan lunges forward to defend, does not pick the wrong 'un and misses the ball, getting hit on the pads.
Tossed up outside off, Perera comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The arm ball around middle, Dilruwan stays back to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. Williams appeals but that was always sliding down leg.
On middle and leg, defended towards short leg.
SEAN WILLIAMS comes on to bowl now.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Short and outside off, punched to deep point for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out again.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Landed outside off, steered behind point for a boundary!
Outside off, played straight to point.
Frustration from Mpofu, a bouncer on middle, Perera ducks.

DROPPED! That was a sitter. Was he celebrating even before taking the catch? A length ball outside off, Dilruwan looks to push it to the off side, but the ball moves away and takes the outside edge. It dips onto Peter Moor behind but still it was a relatively simple chance. He fluffs it. Did not get up at the right time.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Fine shot. Landed outside off, Gunaratne goes back deep in his crease and runs it down to third man.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Full on middle, Dilruwan pushes it uppishly towards mid on. Sees that Chris Mpofu is resting back and charges for the single. Mpofu fires in a throw towards the bowler but it is wide and Dilruwan gets in.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Full on middle, Gunaratne lunges forward to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge wide of short leg towards square leg. A single taken. Moves to 40 and the stand is worth 10 from just 7 balls.
One more leave outside off.
Full and outside off, left alone. That was pretty wide.

FOUR! Uppish but into the gap. Half volley wide outside off, Dilruwan plays a loose cover drive without moving his feet but luckily for him, the ball goes past the man at cover to the fence. 350 UP FOR SRI LANKA.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Outside off, tapped towards point for a single.

FOUR! Valiant effort in the deep but not to much avail. Full on middle and leg, Gunaratne flicks it through square leg. Carl Mumba in the deep dives full length to his right and tries to push the ball back but it rolls back into the ropes.
DILRUWAN PERERA walks in next at number 8.
DRINKS BREAK.

OUT! Cremer has taken a one-handed stunner! Serves a full floated ball on middle, de Silva leans forward and across to turn it on the leg side but fails to close the face of the bat at the right time. It pops out back towards the bowler off the leading edge who stretches full length to his right and takes a stunning catch in front of the non-striker. Well done, skipper! It brings an end to a wonderful knock by Dhananjaya.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. No run.
FOUR! Fine shot! A touch short in length and outside off, de Silva eases himself on the back foot and cuts it sweetly past the point fielder for a boundary.
Flatter one on the pads, it's flicked across the line and hits the shin guard of the short leg fielder. Technically a chance but the fielder there was a shade late in his reflexes.
Flighted full ball outside off, Dhananjaya defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Solid! Full and on off, Gunaratne has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Huge cry of anguish from the bowler as another edge goes to the fence. Good length ball outside off, Asela goes back to defend and does so with a loose bottom hand. As a result the outside edge which gets generated goes safely through the gap between slips and gully.
Bowls it full and around off, Asela defends it off his front foot.
Fullish and angling in, it's defended off the front foot.
Gunaratne lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Fullish and on off, Gunaratne drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Looks to defend it from the crease but it skids through to catch the inside edge. The ball rolls past short leg and collects a run.
Drags his length short and lands it on middle, de Silva goes deep inside the crease and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated one on off, de Silva has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Dhananjaya has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Oohhh...nearly sneaked through! Floated full ball on off, straightening a touch after kissing the turf, de Silva rather than coming forward stays back and defends it at the last moment.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.

EDGY FOUR! This is a good delivery by Mpofu, he lands it on a length and closer to the off stump line, it straightens after pitching and Asela has a push inside the line as he attempts to defend from the crease. The outside edge flies past the second slip fielder for a boundary.

Shot! A full length ball outside off, Gunaratne leans into the drive and places it right through the gap at covers. Waller gives the chase and pulls it back just before the ropes. Poor running between the wickets to gather only two.
Bowls it full and just outside off, slightly quicker, Asela gets across the stumps and pushes it down to mid on.
Once again not much pace, 123 kph fuller length ball outside off, it's left alone by Asela.
Starts with a gentle loosener, a length ball in the zone outside off, not much pace, an easy leave for Gunaratne.
CHRIS MPOFU comes into the attack for the first time this morning, replacing Tiripano. A couple of slips in place.
A touch short and on off, spinning away, Asela gets on the back foot and strokes it through covers for one.
Lovely delivery, nicely tossed up and landing around leg, it spins a bit towards off and the batsman goes back to defend it with soft hands.
Lunges to a full ball and drives it with the spin to covers.
Once again Cremer is on the shorter side, it's on middle, Asela goes back and punches it to short mid-wicket.
Short this time, around off, Dhananjaya goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Beauty first up! A lovely leg spinner landing just outside off, de Silva leans forward to defend but is beaten by the away spin.
GRAEME CREMER brings himself on.
A back foot defensive shot to end the over. The partnership has settled in and started to look dangerous.
FOUR! Fine, fine shot by Asela! He goes deep inside the crease to a short ball and swivels with his pull shot. Middles it exceedingly well and dismisses it through mid on for a boundary.
Picks a full ball from the off stump line and flicks it off the inner half of the bat through square leg for a single.
Full in length and angling back into the batsman, probably staying a touch low, de Silva strides forward and defends it back.
Bowls it short and wide outside off, Dhananjaya reaches out for it and taps it down in front of the gully fielder.
Good length delivery on off, angling in, de Silva defends it off his back foot.
Back of a length ball on middle, clipped behind square leg for a single.
A touch short and outside off, de Silva tries to force it through the line but gets a bottom edge on it. It rolls safely on the leg side.
On a length and angling into the batsman, de Silva plays it off his pads to the leg side and the mid-wicket fielder moves quickly to his right to stop the ball.
Angling in on middle, defended from the pads to the leg side.
Length delivery outside off, Dhananjaya defends it back to the bowler off his back foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Another watchful leave outside the off stump by Gunaratne.
Identical to the last delivery, Gunaratne chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Play and a miss! Gentle delivery, short and wide outside off, Asela flashes and misses.
Drags his length short and around off, Gunaratne pulls it across the line but fails to middle it. Not timed much and it goes on one bounce to the mid-wicket fielder.

Fullish and on off, Gunaratne plays from the front foot to mid off.
Too full in length and outside off, driven through covers for a single.

EDGY FOUR! Dhananjaya is living dangerously. Mumba provides width outside off and de Silva shapes up for a full-blooded cover drive. However, he fails to middle it and the outside edge flies over a couple of slip fielders for a boundary. Not very far from being caught.
DROPPED! Full length ball angling into the batsman, de Silva gets on the front foot and pushes it back uppishly to the bowler. Mumba reacts in his followthrough but fails to take the return catch.
Attempts for a yorker but ends up slipping a low full toss on the pads, it's nudged through backward square leg and Tiripano makes a good stop in the deep. They take a couple of runs.
Slants a full ball on off, angling in, de Silva defends it from the crease to the off side.
Fuller in length and outside off, de Silva gets forward to defend but it comes off the inside edge and ricochets off his pads towards cover-point. A single pinched.
On a length and outside off, it's defended off the back foot to covers by de Silva.
Dhananjaya has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Angles in a length ball on off, Gunaratne gets across the stumps and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Drops it very full and outside off, de Silva gets forward and pushes it through point for a single.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

NOT OUT! And indeed the impact is outside off. A good length ball angling into the batsman from outside off, Asela gets across the stumps and tries to defend but fails to do so. It hits him on the front pad, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Zimbabwe opt for the review. The third umpire first checks for the no ball and it's fine. But the Ball Tracker confirms that the impact was clearly outside off, in fact it was missing the stumps as well. Also, a late call by the onfield umpire to signal FOUR LEG BYES as the keeper failed to collect the ball to his right.
Zimbabwe take their second review of the game. It is for an LBW appeal, which Simon Fry reckons is not out. The impact looked to be outside off to the naked eye.
Fullish and around off, angling in with extra bounce, de Silva gets surprised by the extra lift and takes the bottom hand off the handle. It goes a bit aerial but safely towards point. A run taken.
Another back foot defense offered by the batsman. Mumba resorting to wicket to wicket line!
Good length ball angling into the batsman, defended off the back foot.
Bowls it fuller and outside off, it's driven through the gap at covers. By the time the sweeper in the deep cuts it off, they take a couple of runs.
Pitches it full and outside off, straightening a touch, another leave by Asela.
A gentle delivery in the zone outside off, on a length, Gunaratne strides forward to cover the line and shoulders arms.
Fullish and around off, it's defended off the front foot.
On a length and around off, angling in, Gunaratne gets behind the line and blocks it down safely.
De Silva has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Wrong line and punished! Good length delivery angling down the leg side, Dhananjaya gets across the stumps and nudges it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, Asela has an easy leave.
Too full in length and outside off, Gunaratne squeezes it out to point.
Straighter in line, Gunaratne helps it through backward square leg and Tiripano makes a good tumbling stop. A couple of runs saved.

Oohhh...that was close! Bowls it in the line of the stumps, angling in around off and staying a touch low, Dhananjaya gets back and does well to work it through mid-wicket for one. Had he missed, he would have been a plumb lbw candidate.
Pitches it full and outside off, de Silva plays a flowing cover drive but fails to pierce the gap.
Slants in a fuller length ball on middle, Dhananjaya leans across with the flick shot but misses and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal for an lbw dies quickly. Missing leg.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, Gunaratne shows no intention in playing at it.
Hurls across a length ball in the zone outside off, Gunaratne shoulders arms.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pitches it on a length and around off, straightening a touch, Asela gets squared up in defense and defends it down safely.
First runs of the day! Angles in a length ball on middle, Gunaratne turns it through the gap at square leg and returns for the second run.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Donald Tiripano to bowl from the other end.
De Silva shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lands it a touch shorter on middle, moving back in a bit, Dhananjaya gets back and defends it towards mid on.
Lands it a touch shorter on middle, moving back in a bit, Dhananjaya gets back and defends it towards mid on.
Bowls it full and on off, de Silva gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
A touch short in length and around off, de Silva stays back and defends it down safely.
Starts with a length ball on off, angling in de Silva gets a stride in and defends it to the off side.
The umpires make their way out to the middle. Cremer gets his team into a huddle. Now, de Silva and Gunaratne make their way out.

PITCH REPORT - There are a couple of cracks on the track but nothing major. It might spin a bit but the grass on the surface will hold it together. Batsmen can play well if they negotiate the opening hour.

Dhananjaya de Silva reached his second Test ton and is still going strong. Sri Lanka will hope that he continues with his knock and adds as many as possible with the lower order. The home side needs to keep striking today if they want to avoid a big first innings total. Promises to be another great day of Test cricket. Stay with us.

Welcome everyone for the second day of the second Test match between Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka in Harare. It was an interesting day of Test cricket yesterday where both teams had their fair share of chances. Sri Lanka started well but then hit a roadblock as the hosts made a brilliant comeback. At one stage, the Lankans were tottering on 4/112 but then the 143-run partnership between Upul Tharanga and Dhananjaya de Silva bailed them out.
...DAY 2, FIRST SESSION...

So that ends a competitive day of Test cricket. It was entertaining as well as grinding and in the end, Sri Lanka have their noses in front. However, if the hosts manage to break this partnership quickly tomorrow morning, they might be able to restrict the Lankans around 350. The visitors of course, will aim to bat for as long as possible and repeat their performance of the first Test. Join us back at 1330 IST (0800 GMT) to see how Day 2 unfolds. In the meanwhile, you can catch all the action from the Australia-South Africa Test in Perth which is heading to a conclusion. Adios! Take Care!

Hamilton Masakadza was the surprise package today, as he got 2 wickets in quick succession. It was a toil for the rest, with Tiripano, Mpofu and Cremer getting a wicket each. Carl Mumba, who impressed in the first Test was ineffective today and was a bit uncomfortable after leaving the field post the first over.

To be honest, Zimbabwe did not bowl badly. They were a bit loose in the first hour, probably trying too hard which resulted in a boundary flow but then, they found their rhythm and choked the Lankans for runs. Tharanga and de Silva had to literally put their heads down and play as no free runs were available. But then, slowly the bowlers started to get tired and became a bit inconsistent.

Just as the second new ball was approaching, Cremer got rid of Tharanga via DRS and that sparked a new hope for the home side. But Asela Gunaratne provided an able stand to de Silva to not only see Sri Lanka through to stumps but to help his partner get to his century as well.

It was a mixed day of cricket. Sri Lanka got off to a flier after being asked to bat but then lost their way after a good start. Tharanga and de Silva got together and steadied the proceedings with a 143-run stand for the 5th wicket which calmed the nerves in the dressing room. Majority of the batsmen had thrown it away.

Dhananjaya de Silva has a smile across his face and the Zimbabwean players walk towards him to shake his hands. It has been a wonderful knock and he has not finished yet. Coming in at a precarious time, he has taken the Sri Lankans to a position of safety at the end of the day.
Landed outside off, AG does exactly what he did on the previous ball to see it off. STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Full and outside off, Asela walks forward and defends it to the off side.
A helmet comes in for Peter Moor as he decides to stand up to the stumps. But then, he changes his mind.
Better from the batsman, leaving such non-danger balls go, especially with stumps approaching.
Landed wide outside off, slower in pace, Gunaratne initially looks to let it go but then as an afterthought, dabs it towards third man where gully stops it to his right.
Full and outside off, defended towards mid off.
Landed outside off, pushed towards point.
HAMILTON MASAKADZA to bowl the final over of the day. Can he strike to get this third wicket?
A short ball outside off, helped through square leg for a run.
Second Test ton for Dhananjaya de Silva, first against Zimbabwe!

There it is! A century for de Silva! Takes his helmet off and acknowledges the applause. Goes across and hugs Gunaratne. What a find this player is. Second century in just his 9th Test inning. Superb. A short ball around off, de Silva swivels and comfortably pulls it to Carl Mumba at deep backward square leg. He fumbles but the batsmen are too busy in celebrating and do not notice that there is a chance for the second.
Deep square leg comes in to save the single.
Another short ball outside off, slower in pace, half-pulled between mid on and mid-wicket for a single.
A short ball outside off, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one to move to 99...

DIRECT HIT WOULD HAVE HAD GUNARATNE. Full on middle, Asela pushes it towards mid on and sets off for the run. Brian Chari intercepts from short mid-wicket and dives and in the same motion, flicks at the non-striker's end but misses. Gunaratne was nowhere in the frame.
On middle and leg, worked wide of mid-wicket. Gunaratne sets off for a single but strangely, de Silva sends him back! He then puts up his hand in an apology and smiles.
Full and outside off, driven firmly but straight to mid off.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler who sticks out his left hand and parries it to mid off.
Landed outside off, Dhananjaya looks to punch it away but gets a bottom edge towards the bowler.
Full again, outside off, driven past the bowler but mid off dives to stop the ball.

FOUR! Handsome! That will make him feel loads better! Full and outside off, de Silva leans into the shot and caresses it through the gap between cover and mid off for a boundary to move to 98! The stand is worth 30 now.
Full and outside off, watchfully patted towards cover.
3 overs left and de Silva needs 6 to reach his century tonight. Can he make it?
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Banged in short again, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run to move to 94...
A short ball on middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single. Moves to 10.
Full and wide outside off, left alone.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
A bouncer on middle, Gunaratne goes for the hook but misses.
CHRIS MPOFU has a last burst before stumps.
Pretty full but wide outside off, an easier leave this time.

Similar line and length, this does not move that much, punched back to the bowler.

LEADING EDGE, JUST WIDE! Nervous moment for de Silva. Full on middle, de Silva looks to knock it down to the leg side but gets a leading edge which goes just wide of the bowler towards mid off!
Full and outside off, driven firmly back. Tiripano bends to stop it but the ball deflects off his leg towards cover.
Landed outside off, swinging away, shouldered arms to.
Full and outside off, Gunaratne defends watchfully.
Banged in short outside off, Dds pulls it with a cracking sound to deep mid-wicket for a single. Moves to 93...
Gunaratne looks okay now and we are ready to resume.
There seems to be a problem here. Asela Gunaratne is having an issue with his eyes and the physio is out in the middle. Looks like dirt has gone into his left eye.
A short ball outside off, Dhananjaya goes for the hook but misses. Beaten by pace.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a couple. 8 more...

FOUR! Nicely done. Full on middle and leg, swinging in, de Silva flicks it graciously, with excellent use of his wrists and bisects deep backward square leg and mid-wicket for a boundary!  Moves to 90. Can he get to his century tonight? The stand is worth 21 from just 34 balls.
On a good length outside off, Gunaratne shoulders arms.
More movement. Dhananjaya comes half forward this time and looks to defend but the bat turns in his hand and the ball scurries off the inner half wide of mid on and the batsmen take a single.
Loose from de Silva. The line is outside off and the length is full. De Silva looks to drive but does not move his feet and the ball almost sneaks through. Goes off the inside edge towards mid on.
Again, that same channel, Dds hangs his bat outside off and the ball goes off the inside edge towards short mid-wicket.
Comes back in a long way after pitching outside off, Dhananjaya defends it watchfully.
Full and just outside off, swinging away. de Silva comes forward and defends. Tiripano has been disciplined and controlled with his line and length.
A short ball around off, pulled straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and straight, around off, driven on the bounce to the bowler who mimes a throw at the stumps towards de Silva.
Goes a bit wider, same reaction from the batsman.
Full and outside off, left alone.
Fuller this time, driven straight to mid off.
Short and wide outside off, de Silva jumps to cut but gets it off the bottom half of the bat towards cover.
Tiripano is getting really close to that popping crease. He overstepped on a ball in this over but it went unnoticed. The last thing Zimbabwe want is a wicket of an illegal ball.
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.
Angles this into the right-hander at a pretty full length, AG defends in a compact manner.
The tempter, full and outside off, Asela comes forward and shoulders arms.
On a good length this time, watchfully defended to the off side.
Short and outside off, punched straight to point.

EDGED, FOUR! That runs away. No looseners from Tiripano, runs in and hits the deck at back of a length outside off, gets it to shape away and squares Gunaratne up who was looking to come forward. The ball goes off the outside edge, onto the ground and past second slip to third man.
DONALD TIRIPANO to share the second new ball with Mumba.
Full and outside off, swinging away, driven straight to cover.
Similar ball, swinging away a touch, quietly left alone.
Full and wide outside off, de Silva plays a free-flowing drive past cover for a brace. The stand moves to 11 now.
Too full again, outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Very full and wide outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
Full and outside off, driven sweetly but straight to mid off.
CARL MUMBA gets the second new cherry in his hand. Light is deteriorating really fast. We may not be far away from a stoppage here.
THE SECOND NEW BALL HAS BEEN TAKEN.
Short on middle, Dhananjaya goes back and punches it down the ground to long on for one. Moves to 80.
Full on middle, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, de Silva comes down the track and drives it straight to short extra cover.
Pushes this wide of mid on where Chris Mpofu puts in a good stop to his right. A run taken.
FOUR! That is short and outside off, Gunaratne goes back and punches it through the covers for a boundary to get off the mark.
Short on middle, punched back to the bowler who fumbles and the ball goes through. A single taken.
Tossed up outside off, well kept out. Just a run and a wicket from the over, Cremer has figures of 18-0-57-1.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.

ASELA GUNARATNE walks in at number 7, replacing Tharanga.

OUT! Zimbabwe get a breakthrough just before the second new ball. The decision has been overturned! Beautiful bowling. Full and outside off, Tharanga looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. At least that is what we all felt straightaway. The ball went to the keeper who could not collect it and was searching for the ball. But it lobbed off his hand towards gully where Hamilton Masakadza ran a bit to his left from first slip to take the catch. Umpire Simon Fry did not think there was an edge and Zimbabwe took the review. There was nothing in the replays which could assist the third umpire due to the absence of Hot Spot and Snickometer. But the third umpire overruled the decision, perhaps going by noise. Tharanga falls short of a century and the 143-run stand is broken at last.

Historic moment in Zimbabwe. A review has been taken. Tharanga has looked to drive but missed and a catch has been claimed by Zimbabwe. The umpire has shook his head and the hosts have taken a review.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

The batsman works it down the leg side.

DRINKS BREAK.

Shorter in length, punched back to the bowler.
Around leg stump, de Silva looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Moor appeals for LBW but that was pitched outside leg.
Full and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller in length this time, Tharanga comes forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. 250 IS UP FOR SRI LANKA!

Tossed up generously outside off, eased through the covers for one.

The Zimbabwean bowlers toiled hard but failed to create any chances after the wicket in the session. The pitch has some spin and movement for the bowlers but it's quite minuscule and the current Sri Lankan pair has negotiated them pretty decently.

It was said at the pitch report that the first hour would be the key. Sri Lanka did really well to negotiate the first hour confidently but then threw it way in the next. Can Zimbabwe run through that middle order in the afternoon? Or will the Lankans settle in for some grind? Join us back at 1610 IST (1040 GMT) for the second session.

Mpofu removed Silva towards the end of the session but Upul Tharanga has come out and played a flurry of strokes. Kusal Mendis has looked calm and composed but otherwise most of the Sri Lankan batsmen have tried to be ultra-positive and ended up being too flashy.

It did not start all that well for the home side. Carl Mumba went off the field after bowling the very first over and in the next, Malcolm Waller trotted off too. The hosts then started leaking runs at a horrendous rate till the man with the golden arm, Hamilton Masakadza, struck twice in the space of 6 balls to remove Karunaratne and Kusal Perera.

Excellent period of play for the Zimbabweans. They conceded way too many runs but have picked up three wickets, which is not bad on the first morning of a Test match. Sri Lanka were a bit casual, one feels.

After a heroic fightback in the first Test, a renewed Zimbabwe take on Sri Lanka in the second of the 2-match Test series at Harare. The hosts did lose the game by a big margin but dragged Sri Lanka into the final 30 minutes of the match and almost pulled off an improbable draw. They will look to take confidence from that one and build on the same. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, will agree that they just escaped criticism of not being able to finish off after what was a clinical display over 4 games. They will aim to be as professional as possible here and show who is the boss. Hello and a warm welcome to the second Test between Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka in Harare.
